_doc: Meshes and lights for Kod-placed objects (data/zone_layout.json objects, by class), docs/adr/0003 pass 3. tools/ue/build_world.py spawns `mesh` (build/environment/kit/<mesh>.glb, tools/blender/build_prop_kit.py) at the object's position, plus a warm point light `offset_m` above it. Light intensity in candela; at ~8 lux of daylight these read as glows and become the main light in deep shade and at night. `materials`: the kit's material slots (linear colours; emissive in nits-ish scene units); zone art uses them as 'prop_<name>' slots too (window boxes).
